opis: PANEL 1 (the big one on the left), late afternoon, golden sunset light: the small HEDGEHOG walks along the meadow path from the reference picture, looking up happily at a yellow butterfly fluttering just ahead of him. PANEL 2 (top right), dusk, the sky purple and pink, the sun half gone: the HEDGEHOG follows the first glowing FIREFLIES off the path, deeper into the tall grass towards a row of round dark-green bushes; the path is far behind him. PANEL 3 (bottom right), almost night, deep blue sky with the first stars and a thin moon: only the HEDGEHOG's spiky back and his big worried eyes peek out from inside a round bush; a firefly glows above it. Sad but not scary, a little lost.
